allowPlayersAccept.EnableHint: Check to allow players to accept Quests from Available tab.

allowPlayersCreate.EnableHint: Check to allow players to create Quests. Player created Quests will appear in Available tab with Player Edit permissions. REQUIRES 'create journal' core permission.

allowPlayersDrag.EnableHint: Check to allow Players to drag Rewards from the Quest Details window to their owned Actors.

countHidden.EnableHint: If checked, the number of completed / total objectives will include hidden objectives.

defaultPermissionLevel.EnableHint: Sets the default permission level when new quests are created.

hideGQLFromPlayers.EnableHint: When enabled this option hides the Quest Log from all players. Only GM level users will be able to access the Quest Log.

dateMode.EnableHint: Date used in the quest history and for the deadline of the quests: the date of the world calendar of Foundry or the real date.
dateMode.world: World calendar (added to the real date)

historyVisibility.EnableHint: Decide who can see the History tab of a quest, which logs who completes objectives, takes rewards and changes the status.
historyVisibility.players: Everyone that can see the quest

notifyRewardDrop.EnableHint: Check to show a notification, visible only to GMs, when quest rewards are dropped onto player sheets.

questTrackerResizable.EnableHint: Check to allow manual resizing control of the Quest Tracker.

showFolder.EnableHint: Check to show quest data folder in Journal tab. For DEBUG purposes only.

showTasks.EnableHint: Decide if or how to show the amount of Objectives next to the Quest Title in Quest Log. This has no effect on the Quest Preview.

trustedPlayerEdit.EnableHint: Check to allow trusted players to have expanded quest editing and status control capabilities over quests they have ownership.

Tooltips.HiddenQuestNoPlayers: This Quest is hidden from all players.
